about: ismail public kit by family (ledger M295). Generated by python -m ismail.kit from the sources and ismail/kit_tables.json; edit those and rerun, never this file.

types.sampled: plays real recorded notes or hits (a sample set fetched on the person's word)
types.measured: a code model (waveguide, modal, additive) whose numbers were fitted to recordings
types.mimic: a profile measured from a few real notes (partials, body, noise, room), rebuilt for any note
types.sprite: the built-in subtractive synth or drum synth, a designed patch with no real machine behind it
types.physical: a code model designed from the physics, not fitted to a recording
types.designed: a code voice designed by ear, not modeled on a recording

ear_states.passed: the listener could not tell it from the real thing, blind
ear_states.pending: an exam is out or a round is under way, no verdict yet

voices.name: trumpet
voices.engine: additive lip-reed performer (phrases, slurs, tonguing, techniques as lanes)
voices.exam: blind ear round 1 (five single notes: four not told apart, the plunger reversed); blind phrase round 2 passed; picture rounds 7-10 (real picked 12, 13, 8, 10 of 28); ledger:M331
voices.heard: phrase round 2, blind, on a phone speaker: every clip ticked played, "I cannot tell the difference at all"; the phrases copied a player's take each, an original solo is not judged yet; the lip shake is still caught in picture rounds
voices.range: concert E3-D6 (MIDI 52-86) as measured; to F6 (89) thinner; write concert pitch (the Bb trumpet reads a major second above)
voices.cost: not measured; INFO says: about 6x realtime on one CPU core (a tongued and slurred 32-note line at 120 BPM, 44.1 kHz, 2026-10-25 on a shared laptop); the cost is per phrase (harmonics up to 15 kHz, each with its own level curve)
voices.source: measured: University of Iowa MIS Bb trumpet; Jon Harnum's trumpet effects (CC BY, credit Harnum); Freesound CC0 solo lines (emirdemirel, trumpetplayer); lesson videos measured for numbers only

voices.name: flute
voices.engine: additive air-jet performer (phrases, slurs, tonguing, breaths)
voices.exam: blind picture rounds 8-13 (real picked 20, 18, 16, 19, 11, 15 of 22); ear A/B bossa_flute_ab_1024; ledger:M321
voices.heard: blind A/B in a mix against another flute voice: good in 2 of 3 windows; a sighted pass in a mix ("fingers on a real flute"); no blind round of the flute alone against a player yet
voices.range: B3-Db7 (MIDI 59-97, the Iowa set); C4-C7 is the normal range, the top fifth is thin and loud
voices.cost: not measured; INFO says: 3 to 6x realtime on one CPU core (slurred lines at 120 BPM, 44.1 kHz, 2026-10-24 on a shared laptop; peak memory about 55 MB for 4 bars, 135 MB for a 64 s line); the cost is per phrase (harmonics up to 15 kHz and 21 narrow air bands)
voices.source: measured: University of Iowa MIS flute; Philharmonia Orchestra flute samples (numbers only); solo flute recordings on Wikimedia Commons (public domain; Scott Goff, CC BY-SA 2.0) and Freesound (cms4f, CC0)
